messages:
drew: Quick sync — StratusForge x Redwood lab + Marketplace day on Jun 12. Two tracks: 11:00 PT keynote (marketplace tile rollout) and 13:00 hands-on lab (SI integration + hardware demo). Need RfS: run-of-show, speaker bios/headshots, demo fallback plan, and live listing by 10:30 PT. Who owns which items?

maria: I can own partner coordination for StratusForge. Confirmed speakers: StratusForge Head of Product (Ravi) and Redwood Eng Lead (Ashok). Ravi needs travel + hotel ETA.

jenna: Marketing will own promo + co-branded tile. Send one-line session hooks for each track. Also need embargo guidance — product/compliance requests a 48h pre-publication review for claims.

rachel (si): For the SI deep-dive Ill bring a preseeded tenant and sample data. Whats our policy on retaining demo logs after teardown?

ashok: Hands-on primary runs on StratusForge test cluster on-site. Fallback plan: Redwood Dedicated snapshot (local USB) + bonded hotspot NAT. Ill pin a container image and provide a rollback script.

lucy: Demo flows: (A) ingestion -> embedding -> semantic search (3 mins), (B) failover + troubleshooting (4 mins). Ill author a concise script and pared-down slides for the lab.

kevin: Shipping: 2 demo Nexus boxes + spare SSDs, courier pickup Jun 10. Ill include local image, serials sheet, and return labels. Need custodian name for venue check-in and sign-out protocol.

drew: AV check at 09:00 on event day. Can we do a 30-min micro-run at 10:00? Also need Q&A moderation and chat ops.

jenna: Marketing will triage chat + handle embargo escalations. Captioning booked. Promo draft by Jun 3.

ashok: Preflight commands (run on the lab machine):

```
# health
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9000/health
# sample query
curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:9000/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Create short summary","max_tokens":80}'
```

maria: StratusForge legal needs co-announcement copy by Jun 5 and requests a 48h review window. Can marketing accept?

jenna: 48h is acceptable. Well schedule public announcement 48h after recording; if speakers need changes we hold video release.

rachel: SI notes: Ill circulate the connector package + install checklist. Prefer to share creds via secure vault to the 'si-demo' account only.

ashok: Ill provision temporary demo creds in the vault (expiry Jun 13) and add a log-bundle script that redacts PII.

kevin: Shipping labels live. Tracking: SF-680-RT. Uploading asset manifest to partner drive and will DM tracking.

calendar-bot: Event created: "StratusForge x Redwood  Marketplace + Hands-on Lab" Jun 12, 11:00-14:00 PT. Rehearsals: 09:00 AV check, 10:00 micro-run, 15:30 dry-run. (thread_ts: 1798754321)

drew: Action owners recap:
- Maria: partner comms, speaker bios/headshots, co-announcement copy
- Jenna: promo + tile creative, embargo coordination
- Ashok: demo image, vault creds, logs redaction
- Lucy: demo script, moderator
- Kevin: shipping + on-site custodian
- Rachel: SI connector & install checklist

Please ack and flag blockers.

maria: Ack. Bios by Jun 2. Legal may request wording tweaks.

jenna: Ack. Promo draft Jun 3.

ashok: Ack. Image and USB hash will be uploaded to the vault.

lucy: Ack. Script in /docs/events/stratusforge-lab.md by Jun 5.

kevin: Ack. Courier booked.

rachel: Ack. Connector package by Jun 4.

drew: Thanks all  Ill send final invite and run-of-show by Jun 7. Update this thread if anything changes. :rocket:
